fact: NeST, rolled out on 1 July 2023, has run 130,032 tenders for ministries, departments and agencies, according to PPRA director general Dennis Simba.
PPRA director general Dennis Simba said NeST had handled 130,032 tenders worth Sh14.9 trillion.

PPRA Director General Eliakim Maswi says the Public Procurement Act No. 10 of 2023, in force 17 June 2024, mandates use of the National e-Procurement System of Tanzania (NeST) for all procurement processes.
PPRA's chief executive says a government directive requires all procurement on Tanzania Mainland to be conducted through NeST only from 1 October 2023.
The Public Procurement Bill 2023, per PPRA's chief executive, mandates electronic systems in all procurement with no offline option, on pain of up to three years' jail or a TZS 10 million fine.
